description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android Tic Tac Toe game. It sets up click listeners for starting a game either with a human or the computer, and initiates the game activity with the selected starting player.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity initializes the app UI, handles user interaction to start a new game, and launches the game activity with the chosen start mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; sets up UI and click listeners.

methods.name: startGame
methods.description: Starts the game by creating an intent and passing the starting player info to GameActivity.
